title: 저출산ㆍ고령사회 기본법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Form and other matters of the application for the first meeting voucher)
① The application for the first meeting voucher (hereinafter referred to as "first meeting voucher") as stipulated in each item of Article 1(2) of the "Act on Basic Measures for Low Birthrate and Aging Society" (hereinafter referred to as "the Act"), excluding the portions thereof, shall be in accordance with the common form as stipulated in Article 4(1).
② In Article 1(2) of the Act, "documents as specified in the Minister of Health and Welfare's ordinance" refers to the documents specified in any of the following items:
1. Resident registration certificate
2. Driver's license
3. Disability registration certificate
4. Passport
5. Foreigner registration certificate
6. Other documents that can be used to verify identity, as determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare
③ The delegation as stipulated in Article 1(2) of the Act shall be in accordance with the annexed form.
④ In Article 1(2) of the Act, "documents as specified in the Minister of Health and Welfare's ordinance" refers to the documents specified in any of the following items:
1. Family relationship certificate as stipulated in Article 15(1)(1) of the "Act on Registration of Family Relationships," etc.
2.

Detailed certificate for a birth certificate issued under Article 15(3) of the "Act on Registration of Family Relationships, etc."

⑤ The mayor/governor of a special autonomous city, the mayor/governor of a special autonomous province, the mayor/county executive, and the head of a district office (referring to the head of a district office in a self-governing district, hereinafter referred to as "the head of a district office") must verify the resident registration certificate, etc., through the joint use of administrative information under Article 36(1) of the "Electronic Government Act" when they receive an application for the provision of a "first meeting voucher" under Article 1(2)(2) of the Act. However, if the person requesting the voucher does not agree to the verification, the relevant documents must be attached.
